prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Selection Flow: Adds a new pet trait selection screen (new_trait_selection) into the adoption flow where users choose visual style preferences before uploading photos or picking pets.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_trait_selection", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Personalize Your Desktop Companion"}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Visual Narrative Redesign: Redesigns the story intro screen to a story_scroll layout with animated visual cards highlighting key pet companion features.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Scroll to discover how your desktop pet lives, plays, and assists on your screen."}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Split Layout Account Sync Sign-In Screen: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout featuring real-time account pet restoration status alongside login options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pet", "body": "Log in to secure your companion data, access your pet across devices, and restore previous pets.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Pet Sync Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Hatching Stage Screen: Inserts a new waiting stage screen (new_hatching_stage) during background rendering that showcases interactive companion hatching visuals.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "new_hatching_stage", "waiting", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home"}}
4: [finish, redesign] Interactive Home Welcome Stage Layout: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a stage layout with clear visual indicators for pet controls and tray activation.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look at your desktop screen to find your pet. Use the system tray icon anytime to interact, minimize, or adjust settings.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Active on Desktop", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
5: [adoption, layout] Certificate Stage Layout Customization: Swaps the adoption certificate screen layout to a stage view that highlights official pet adoption details and companion badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Your companion adoption is complete and saved to your account."}}
6: [home, notification] Background Generation Desktop Ready Notification: Enables automatic background desktop notification alerts when the pet finishes hatching while the user is in another app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you!"}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Direct Outcome Headline: Updates the choose path screen headline and body text to clearly contrast custom pet creation versus instant preset companion adoption.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Path: Create Custom or Adopt Instant Companion", "body": "Generate a unique pet from your photos or select from our curated starter companions immediately."}}
8: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Account Pet Sync Security Badge: Displays a cloud account security badge component on the sign-in screen reassuring users that pet progress is safely backed up.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "100% Cloud Saved Companion Data", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] System Tray & Desktop Controls Tip Carousel: Adds a tip carousel component to the final home intro screen explaining how to locate, summon, and control the pet from the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Click the System Tray icon to summon or customize your pet anytime!", "style": "rounded"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a new trait selection step into onboarding is allowed under rule 4 and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning the story screen layout is allowed under rule 4 and preserves the story's function.
Redesigning the sign-in screen is allowed under rule 4 and maintains sign-in functionality.
Adding a new waiting stage screen inside onboarding is permitted under rule 4.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout is allowed as home intro is part of onboarding.
Customizing the certificate layout is allowed and retains official adoption certificate details.
Enabling desktop notification during the waiting stage is allowed under rule 4.
Updating path selection copy preserves both custom creation and preset adoption options.
Adding a cloud security badge component to sign-in is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a tip carousel component to home intro is allowed within onboarding.
